question: Guru Bipin Singh received ‘Sangeet Natak Akademi Award’ in the year 1966. He was a teacher of _______ dance.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Manipuri.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Bipin ****Singh **was a **director, choreographer and teacher of Manipuri dance.**
 
• The **Manipuri Dance** also referred to as the **Manipuri Raas Leela, **is **one of the eight major Indian classical dance forms, originating from the state of Manipur**.** **
 
• He received many awards other than **Sangeet Natak Award and Kalidas Samman** from Madhya Pradesh Government are major award received by him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is **one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance**. Kathak is characterized by **intricate footwork and precise rhythmic patterns that the dancer articulates by controlling about 100 ankle bells**.
 
• **Odissi** is recognised as one of the eight classical dance forms of India and is **celebrated around the world for its lyricism, sensuality and emphasis on bhakti bhava (attitude of devotion and surrender).**
 
• **Bharatanatyam** traces its origins back to the **Natyashastra**, an ancient treatise on theatre written by the** mythic priest Bharata.** Originally a temple dance for women, Bharatanatyam often is used to express** Hindu religious stories **and** devotions.**
